translations.web: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.
translations.bsb: In the second year of his reign, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams that troubled his spirit, and sleep escaped him.
